label: Local operation unity by restricted realization and complete intrinsic profile (inference)
rule: Apply the existing realizer-collapse law to the selected operation subtype and derive restricted injection from profile completeness
meaning: Uses ImitabilityPlurality.identityAndRankingLaws, with the subtype of operations at the same actual bearer and exercise as its carrier. Equal real realizers plus matching bearer/exercise give token equality only through the explicit profile-completeness premise. This is a scoped reuse application, not a new collapse principle or a derivation of metaphysical act individuation. No object-profile identity is assumed.
